coupons.what: upper-tee slip, WET, at the LOW scatter torque 1.05 N m on all 4 bolts: 300 mm offcut of the 545 mm stay, 15 mm free end above 100 mm shells from Speedy p-4573, 3/16 backers; (a) pull along the stay, (b) twist about the stay with a 300 mm lever on the bar stub; n 5; also dry, and wet after 24 h at 40 C
coupons.pass: (a) every wet axial slip load >= 1825 N and (b) every wet torque slip >= 23.2 N m (1.2 x the factored demand 1521 N / 19.3 N m, side hill C3 incl. C6p); no tube dent > 0.1 mm
coupons.settles: MU 0.15 wet, EMBED 0.9, K 0.2 at the low limit, SHELL-FIT

coupons.what: upper-tee fatigue (review 9 B4): same coupon at the HIGH scatter torque 1.95 N m, clamped 75 mm below the shells; on the T5 crank rig cycle 0 -> 1.2 x walk: bar couple 5.8 N m, bar push 253 N, IM3 loop 906 N; R 0, n 3, 2e5 cycles (2 x life)
coupons.pass: no crack (dye penetrant under and beside both shell edges and at the free end), no fretting debris track > 0.5 mm wide, re-torque check: >= 80 % of the set torque to move the bolts
coupons.settles: design curve + fretting 0.6 (FRET-METAL), CLAMP-UNIFORM / SHELL-FIT, Kt 2

coupons.what: mid-saddle fatigue: 400 mm stay offcut in 4-point bending on the T5 rig with the printed saddle + a crown-leg offcut and its UHMWPE leg-end bushing inside under the saddle (covers the bushing row too) + band at 1.5 N m in the constant-moment span; R 0.1, S_max at the saddle 87 MPa (1.2 x the walk 73 MPa, M 60 N m), n 3, 2e5 cycles
coupons.pass: no crack at the saddle edges (dye penetrant); saddle not cracked

coupons.what: upper bar end in double shear: bar stub + 2 bolts + spacers between the two upper backers, held as in the tee; load the bar as a cantilever to the factored couple 59 N m, hold 2 min, then to failure
coupons.pass: no permanent set > 0.2 mm at the bar tip after 59 N m; ultimate >= 89 N m
coupons.settles: bar-wall bearing at e/D 1.9, bolt double shear, backer bending (M8 metal path)

coupons.what: fit-up on the built frame: (a) torque the upper tees to the high limit with leg + bushing inside, pull the leg with a spring scale; (b) set the crown to the 15 in torso and gauge the stay-top collar to the crown corner; (c) ID of the p-4573 shells vs the stay OD with calipers before sawing
coupons.pass: (a) leg slide <= 20 N, feeler >= 0.3 mm radial at the bushing mouth; (b) >= 5 mm clear (else shorten the stay extension and re-run with the measured free end); (c) shell ID - stay OD <= 0.35 mm

coupons.what: mid saddle pull-off: socket + bar stub on a stay offcut, pull the bar away from the stay
